shortDescription: Manage user quota on the Unity storage system

options.name: cap_unit
options.description: Unit of I(soft_limit) and I(hard_limit) size. It defaults to C(GB) if not specified.

options.name: filesystem_id
options.description: The ID of the filesystem for which the user quota is created. For creation of a user quota either I(filesystem_id) or I(filesystem_name) is required.

options.name: filesystem_name
options.description: The name of the filesystem for which the user quota is created. For creation of a user quota either I(filesystem_name) or I(filesystem_id) is required.

options.name: hard_limit
options.description: Hard limitation for a user on the total space available. If exceeded, user cannot write data. Value C(0) implies no limit. One of the values of I(soft_limit) and I(hard_limit) can be C(0), however, both cannot be C(0) during creation or modification of user quota.

options.name: nas_server_id
options.description: The ID of the NAS server in which the filesystem is created. For creation of a user quota either I(filesystem_id) or I(filesystem_name) is required.

options.name: nas_server_name
options.description: The name of the NAS server in which the filesystem is created. For creation of a user quota either I(nas_server_name) or I(nas_server_id) is required.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the Unity management server.

options.name: path
options.description: The path to the quota tree. Either I(tree_quota_id) or I(path) to quota tree is required to create/modify/delete user quota for a quota tree. Path must start with a forward slash '/'.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number through which communication happens with Unity management server.

options.name: soft_limit
options.description: Soft limitation for a user on the total space available. If exceeded, notification will be sent to the user for the grace period mentioned, beyond which the user cannot use space. Value C(0) implies no limit. Both I(soft_limit) and I(hard_limit) cannot be C(0) during creation or modification of user quota.

options.name: state
options.description: The I(state) option is used to mention the existence of the user quota.

options.name: tree_quota_id
options.description: The ID of the quota tree. Either I(tree_quota_id) or I(path) to quota tree is required to create/modify/delete user quota for a quota tree.

options.name: uid
options.description: User ID of the user quota.

options.name: unispherehost
options.description: IP or FQDN of the Unity management server.

options.name: user_name
options.description: User name of the user quota when I(user_type) is C(Windows) or C(Unix). Option I(user_name) must be specified along with I(win_domain) when I(user_type) is C(Windows).

options.name: user_quota_id
options.description: User quota ID generated after creation of a user quota.

options.name: user_type
options.description: Type of user creating a user quota. Mandatory while creating or modifying user quota.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the Unity management server.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether or not to validate SSL certificate. C(true) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.

options.name: win_domain
options.description: Fully qualified or short domain name for Windows user type. Mandatory when I(user_type) is C(Windows).
